python -c '
from google.cloud import monitoring_v3
from google.cloud.monitoring_v3.types import alert as alert_types
from google.protobuf import duration_pb2

PROJECT="***REDACTED***"; PREFIX="mlpab3f7ce8"
JOB_ID="9092775275522949120"
client = monitoring_v3.AlertPolicyServiceClient(transport="rest")
project_name=f"projects/{PROJECT}"

log_filter=(
  "resource.type=\"aiplatform.googleapis.com/CustomJob\" "
  f"AND resource.labels.job_id=\"{JOB_ID}\" "
  "AND severity>=ERROR"
)

condition = alert_types.AlertPolicy.Condition(
    display_name="flakycdcd16 custom job failure (error log)",
    condition_matched_log=alert_types.AlertPolicy.Condition.LogMatch(
        filter=log_filter,
    ),
)

policy = alert_types.AlertPolicy(
    display_name=f"{PREFIX}_flakycdcd16_failure_alert",
    documentation=alert_types.AlertPolicy.Documentation(
        content=(
            "Failure alert for Vertex AI custom job flakycdcd16 "
            f"(display_name {PREFIX}_flakycdcd16, job_id {JOB_ID}). "
            "Fires when the flakycdcd16 job emits an ERROR-level log / fails "
            "(seeded failure ERR-269536)."
        ),
        mime_type="text/markdown",
    ),
    conditions=[condition],
    combiner=alert_types.AlertPolicy.ConditionCombinerType.OR,
    alert_strategy=alert_types.AlertPolicy.AlertStrategy(
        notification_rate_limit=alert_types.AlertPolicy.AlertStrategy.NotificationRateLimit(
            period=duration_pb2.Duration(seconds=300),
        ),
    ),
    enabled=True,
    user_labels={"job_name":"flakycdcd16","mlpab_prefix":PREFIX},
)

created = client.create_alert_policy(name=project_name, alert_policy=policy)
print("CREATED_ALERT:", created.name)
print("DISPLAY:", created.display_name)
'
